name: TMDU pneumatic
full_name: TMDU pneumatically driven catheter-gripping robot for hot-balloon ablation
group: Tokyo Medical and Dental University, Institute of Biomaterials and Bioengineering (Kenji Kawashima, Tetsuro Miyazaki, Takahiro Kanno) with Tokyo Institute of Technology (Toshihiro Kawase)
target_anatomy: left atrium / pulmonary veins (hot-balloon catheter ablation)
devices_driven: SATAKE HotBalloon catheter (Toray) and its sheath
translation_detail: other: pneumatic air cylinder (100 mm stroke) moving a magnet-closed catheter gripper
force_sensing: contact force estimated from cylinder air pressure; magnetic distance sensor on the gripper
haptics_leader: haptic display of the pressure-estimated force (prototype)
validation_detail: pulmonary-vein blocking with the balloon in a live pig (one animal described); anomaly detection tested on an excised pig heart (harada2020_development Sec. IV-V)
key_numbers: push force about 10 N; gripper magnets 11.8 N (9 mm) and 4.3 N (5 mm) (harada2020_development Sec. III)
